name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Chicken thigh strips marinated 30 minutes in a quick chili-soy mixture, sautéed with peppers and onion, and served in warm tortillas with Pepper Jack.
recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.name: Mix the marinade
recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine 1 Tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp sugar, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1/8 tsp Tabasco sauce, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp crushed red pepper flakes and blend well.

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate
recipeInstructions.text: Place 1 1/2 lbs chicken thigh strips in the sauce, stirring to coat. Cover and let sit 30 minutes at room temperature.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Drain the chicken, discarding the marinade. Add the chicken to a pan with 1 Tbsp olive oil and cook 5 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the vegetables
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 chopped onion and the sliced green and red bell peppers and sauté another 3 to 5 minutes, until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and the vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with 2 Tbsp lemon juice and remove from the heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: Make fajitas with 8 warmed flour tortillas, the chicken filling and 1 cup shredded Pepper Jack cheese.
